body:
The macOS production-gate structure preflight timed out after 300 seconds in `gate_capture_drain_structure` at revision 40e2925f32800702e3dfd42d31d0fe63760cf65c on branch `ipc/813-pr-b-unix-stream-write-waiters`. It completed 65/66 suites and never reached the production build or QEMU launch.

The pending test was `drain_disabled_reads_partial_drain_enabled_reads_complete_same_race`, using the FIFO-coordinated fixture imported from 62988b29. Its enabled serial file contained the complete END record, but the fixture shell remained blocked. The shell resolved to Homebrew Bash 5.3.15. Standalone traced reproductions completed under both system Bash and the PATH-selected Bash, so the precise cause is not established.

The single authorized gate retry uses unchanged source and `BREENIX_STRUCTURE_SUITE_TIMEOUT_SECS=900`. The retry passed preflight 66/66 and the production boot 1/1. The capture-drain suite passed 6/6. The host snapshot after the initial timeout recorded one-minute load average 86.49. No scoring criteria or preflight bypass changed.

Evidence is being committed in the branch under `docs/planning/green-program/ipc/serials/813-b/`: `proof-arm-prod-preflight-timeout.txt`, `preflight-arm-prod-timeout/`, `prod-timeout-host.txt`, and `capture-repro-*.txt`. The final retry result belongs in the round doc `docs/planning/green-program/ipc/813-PR-B-2026-09-07.md`.

Follow-up: determine which FIFO open/read or shell lifecycle step can stall under suite concurrency, add a deterministic bounded reproduction if possible, and repair the fixture without replacing the partial/complete evidence checks with weaker criteria. This report does not establish a Unix kernel defect.
title: Investigate intermittent macOS capture-drain structure fixture timeout
